method: Public HTML and JavaScript read over HTTP only; no browser or runtime observation.

sourceDeclarations.measurement: Actual content rectangles and fallback data-skeleton-shape roles (name, meta, body, avatar) provide source and target geometry.
sourceDeclarations.completion: Source fades each row after its own expansion; one branch preserves the first row and starts later rows at zero height.

localChoices.sequence: One continuous 280ms layer entrance across SPA fallback/measuring/measured slots; morph both first rows over 320ms while remaining rows join downward expansion at 20/40/60/80ms, each lasting 320ms. Shape/height/opacity use cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1). Wait for all geometry and paint, then crossfade content/skeleton top-to-bottom over 280ms with an independent 80ms stagger on SSR/SPA. Splash exits directly into shell entrance. These are local user-requested overlapping choreography choices, not source observations; sourceDeclarations remain unchanged.
localChoices.geometry: Use transforms for matched shapes, opacity for new/obsolete skeleton shapes, bounded height/padding/border animation for card flow.
localChoices.contentBarrier: User explicitly requires all expansion to complete before any real data appears; this differs from source per-row completion.
localChoices.panel: Initial and real feed panels share a 100dvh minimum height; no whole-panel height tween.
localChoices.limits: At most six measured cards, twelve regions and thirty-six shapes per card including old-shape ghosts.
localChoices.verification: Source module17258 fetched again over HTTP on 2026-10-16; it starts geometry immediately and fades each row on completion via requestAnimationFrame, without two 300ms holds. Pure state/shape regression cases added but not run; no build, tests, performance scripts or browser verification run.
